headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 12, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers edged out the Cleveland Guardians 6-4 in a closely contested matchup, with Chase DeLauter leading the Guardians' offense with 3 hits, including a home run. The Miami Marlins secured a 2-0 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eury Pérez earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several key players have been affected by injuries, including Jake Bloss (Toronto Blue Jays), Riley Greene (Detroit Tigers), Kyle Karros (Colorado Rockies), José Suarez (Athletics), Blake Treinen (Los Angeles Dodgers), Isiah Kiner-Falefa (Boston Red Sox), Kervin Castro (New York Yankees), and Hunter Greene (Cincinnati Reds). The status of these players has been updated, with some being placed on the injured list.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Boston Red Sox trading CF Harold Rivas to the Baltimore Orioles, the Miami Marlins trading 1B Jacob Berry to the Kansas City Royals, and the Athletics trading RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics for RF Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Cleveland Guardians 6-4 in a closely contested matchup. Chase DeLauter led the Guardians' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Drew Anderson pitched 4 strong innings for the Guardians.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 2-0 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eury Pérez earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Esteury Ruiz led the Pirates' offense with a home run and RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Nationals 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jacob Webb earned the save with 1.1 scoreless innings, striking out 2 batters.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Mariners 4-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 4-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Randy Arozarena leading the Mariners' offense with a home run and an RBI. Bryan Woo pitched 5 strong innings for the Mariners, striking out 5 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 7-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles in their recent matchup. Impact hitters for the Twins included Royce Lewis, Brooks Lee, and Leody Taveras, while the Orioles' Josh Bell and Victor Caratini also made notable contributions.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Phillies 7-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies in a one-sided matchup, securing a 7-1 victory. Alec Bohm and Alec Burleson were among the impact hitters for the Phillies, while Kyle Leahy stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays RHP Bloss Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right-handed pitcher Jake Bloss has been placed on the 60-day injured list, marking a significant update to the team's roster.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
